full_name: Kathleen Cash | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2007–2008 Social Sciences Hrdy Fellow Independent Scholar
bio: Kathleen Cash is an independent researcher and educator interested in integrative methodologies that bring social change to economically and educationally disadvantaged women and youths.
